name: 到達章をたどる読書計画
prompt:
Edit the existing generated reading-plan candidate in reference 1. Keep its Japanese content and restrained appearance, but correct its canvas scale and card geometry to match reference 2. Reference 2 is the exact 390 by 780 Japanese native preview and is the authority for layout and wording. The candidate in reference 1 currently has too much empty space above the first card, cards shifted left, an oversized first card, and text that is too large. Correct those exact issues. Do not let the crop or layout of the original app screenshot override the native preview.

Canvas: portrait 390 by 780, full bleed pure white. No device frame, status bar, app navigation, extra top margin, or content below the preview. The first card starts at x54 y8, width320 height202. The second card starts at x54 y234, width320 height124. The third starts at x54 y386, width320 height124. The fourth starts at x54 y538, width320 height124. Keep the timeline at x26, extending from y18 to y738, with 14px nodes centered at y39, y265, y417, and y569. Keep all four cards fully visible and inside the same viewport. Align the whole stack to these coordinates; do not enlarge the content to fill space.

Use white card and badge surfaces only, subtle neutral gray outlines, no mint, pink, blue, or green tinted surface fills, no colored wash, no colored shadows, and no gradients. Keep forest green #174C36 only for the narrow first-card top rule, small outline milestone icons, and the first active marker's outline and center dot. Future markers and timeline remain neutral gray. Preserve the natural pink ring only as part of the protected portrait artwork in reference 4; do not add pink elsewhere. Use near-black text and restrained gray supporting text.

Preserve the exact Japanese wording and hierarchy from reference 2: 到達点 1, 21日間, 3月3日, 読み始めましょう, 進行役・ジャクリーン, 案内役, ようこそ！, 到達点 2, 3月12日, ここまで読む, 第25章・見知らぬ人, 到達点 3, 3月22日, 第50章・モレル一家, 到達点 4, 4月1日, 第75章・証言, 次の節目へ続きます. Use compact Japanese typography matching the preview: 20px bold milestone titles, 14px bold dates, 12px badges/labels, 14px welcome text; do not upscale. Preserve the facilitator bookshelf photo from reference 4 unchanged, including crop and pink ring. Reference 3 is only for original icon shape and card anatomy; exclude its phone chrome and header. Reference 5 is only for the owner's neutral color preference, not its layout. Keep the four-card sequence simple, readable, and aligned; introduce no additional controls, icons, illustrations, or content.
reviewNotes: White cards and badges remove tinted fills, but the stack remains vertically displaced and the first card is oversized relative to the native preview; exact protected portrait preservation is unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
